content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Jamshedpur Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Jamshedpur JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Jamshedpur is 15th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MTech/ME or equivalent degree in Electrical Engineering with a specialization in Power System or High Voltage Engineering and must have qualified in the GATE examination.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post announced by NIT Jamshedpur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow will be Rs. 37,000/- per month plus HRA for the first and second year, and Rs. 42,000/- per month plus HRA for the third year.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for this recruitment must be submitted via Email.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the NIT Jamshedpur JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for General/OBC and SC/ST category candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is NIT Jamshedpur located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Jamshedpur is located in Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, with the pincode 831014.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is NITJSR/DEE/2026/171.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position is a contractual role.
